0022600144.text: Atlanta (2-3) hosts Cleveland (3-1) in the Hawks' sixth game of the 2026-27 season, with the Hawks 0-2 at home and 2nd in the Southeast, 1 game back, while the Cavaliers sit 2nd in the Central, 0.5 games back, and have won three straight. The Hawks, 7th in the East, have lost three in a row, while Cleveland, 5th in the East, has won three in a row and is 3-0 at home. The teams split 2-2 in 2025-26 and have not met yet this season, and Atlanta's last meeting was a 124-102 Hawks win in Atlanta on April 10, 2026, with Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture) both out for the Hawks.
